block.description: [[block]]: shared texts and facts, used as [[id]] in any text.

id.description: Id of the block; write [[id]] in a text to include it: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and dashes.

show.description: Ids of people or factions whose sheets show this block as a section.

items.description: Id of people or factions whose sheets show this block as a section.

status.description: How far the writing is; shown in the progress panel.

text.description: The text; may include other blocks and names as [[id]].

title.description: Heading when the block is shown on a sheet.
